title: Alchemy Cauldrons
text:
Place ingredients in the cauldron's nine input slots. Elemental totals use spiritual growth times stack count, not a plant's Qi-source reserve.

Channel Qi Transfer into the cauldron to charge and ignite it. With enough Qi, the ingredients refine into a pill or remnants. Every input stack is consumed. Leave an output slot free. The starter cauldron loses one stored Qi per five idle seconds.

Jade slips teach recipes. Analyzing a pill in the Bind slot reveals that pill without consuming it, but does not teach its recipe.
